analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100 ($69.01)/SMA200 ($64.76): Below long-term trends, approaching SMA200.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (43.5→36.4): Entering oversold, downward momentum continues.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.3885→-0.3109): Improving but still in negative territory, no confirmation of trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (near Lower Band $62.90): Approaching lower band, band width at 13.93% suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($57.54): Potential for further decline if Pivot S1 ($59.78) and SMA200 ($64.76) are breached.
· Swing Resistance ($68.35): Resistance zone at SMA50 ($69.20) and Bollinger Upper Band ($72.32).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Confirmation of support at lows, potential for rebound attempt.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.67x): Low confidence in price movement, requiring caution.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Consider buying upon RSI oversold exit and Higher Low pattern confirmation, approach cautiously due to ADX lacking trend formation.
